decisions.limitation: Remains above zero error rate  (weakness of: FactProbe: A Benchmark for Measuring Hallucination in Large Language Models)
decisions.evidence: GraphVerify lowers the hallucination rate from about 18% to 7%

decisions.limitation: Does not eliminate unsupported claims  (weakness of: FactProbe: A Benchmark for Measuring Hallucination in Large Language Models)

decisions.limitation: Requires continued work on verification  (weakness of: FactProbe: A Benchmark for Measuring Hallucination in Large Language Models)
decisions.evidence: GraphVerify makes Hallucination Reduction operational by checking every claim after generation.

decisions.limitation: Graph coverage remains a limitation  (weakness of: SubGround: Retrieving Query-Specific Subgraphs to Ground Language Model Answers)
decisions.evidence: SubGround retrieves a compact Knowledge Graph neighborhood.

decisions.limitation: Fails when needed relation is absent  (weakness of: SubGround: Retrieving Query-Specific Subgraphs to Ground Language Model Answers)
